text:
maria: quick triage — crow-1b (int8) onboarding looks off vs pelican-v2. ran wiki-holdout recall@5 and cluster silhouette. recall@5 dropped ~6.2% and kmeans shows lots of tiny clusters. sharing quick outputs.
ajay: can you paste eval command / config? index type, normalization, pq/hnsw params?
maria: sure — ran with ANN: HNSW + PQ, L2-normalized embeddings. eval cmd:```./eval_embeddings --model crow-1b-int8 --dataset wiki-holdout --index hnsw --pq 64x8 --normalize true --k 5 --batch 512```
leah: hmm PQ 64x8 + int8 on top might be compounding. were embeddings produced with quant-aware rounding?
maria: no special quant-aware training. just post-quant int8 via our ONNX pipeline.
samir: first quick checks: 1) compare L2 norms distribution vs pelican-v2, 2) check mean-centering shift, 3) look at nearest neighbor distance ratios. small drift in norms can break L2-normalized recall.
maria: ran a norm diff: pelican median L2=1.01, crow median L2=0.86. so crow vectors are tighter.
leah: that explains fragmentation — after normalize, smaller spread clusters overlap differently. try rescaling (divide by std then renorm) or skip global norming and use inner product (no normalize).
ajay: also try lowering PQ buckets or use OPQ / per-channel scale. PQ + int8 can distort small-magnitude coords.
elaine: infra note — ops-bot deployed crow-1b-int8 to staging pool at 3319876580 :deploy: (staging/gpu-pool-3).
ops-bot: deploy-bot: model crow-1b-int8 successfully deployed to staging/gpu-pool-3 (image: inference:v2.14).
eval-bot: auto-eval completed 3319876610: recall@1: -8.9% vs baseline, recall@5: -6.2%, avg_cosine_drop: 0.043, silhouette_avg: 0.21 -> baseline 0.36. full csv uploaded to /evals/3319876543/crow-int8-report.csv
samir: can you run two quick reruns: A) same pipeline but no normalize + cosine inner product B) post-scale (std) then renorm + same index. small wall time.
maria: kicking both now. batch 512, will post short results.
leah: also try HNSW efConstruction=400 and efSearch=128 for sanity — connectivity can affect cluster sizes.
ajay: if rerun B improves, we should add a normalization preprocessor step in onboard pipeline for int8 models. if not, try PQ=32x8 or OPQ.
maria: interim results: run A (no normalize) recall@5 delta: -1.1% (much better). run B (rescale+renorm) recall@5 delta: -0.9%. silhouette B: 0.33.
elaine: good signal. sounds like normalization/rescale solves most of it.
leah: my takeaway — crow-1b int8 embeddings have lower norm magnitude. we should: 1) add norm sanity check in onboarding, 2) default to rescale+renorm for quantized embeddings, 3) recommend PQ tweaks.
ajay: agreed. file a small onboarding PR with eval threshold and auto-rescaler. @maria can you open the PR with diffs and include A/B plots?
maria: will do. creating PR now, tagging @leah for PQ recommendations and @samir for normative checks. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
ops-bot: reminder: schedule nightly full-eval for crow-1b-int8 at 03:00 UTC to collect more metrics across multilingual holdouts.
leah: also add a brief note in the model-catalog about int8 norm caveat so infra and customers know to expect rescale step.
maria: noted — PR + model-catalog blurb incoming.
